name: The 4th CHiME Speech Separation and Recognition Challenge
description: CHiME-4 is a benchmark corpus designed for speech separation and recognition in realistic, challenging noisy environments using 1-, 2-, or 6-channel tablet microphone arrays. Based on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ0) reading task, it incorporates both real recordings made in four public locations (cafe, street junction, public transport, pedestrian area) and simulated noisy conditions with reverberation.
